name: Politician
ability: If you were the player most responsible for your team losing, you change alignment & win, even if dead.
drunk_or_poisoned: A drunk or poisoned Politician cannot change alignment; they lose with their team.

jinxes.text: The Politician might register as evil to Legion.
If the Pit-Hag turns an evil player into the Politician, they can't turn good due to their own ability.

rulings.text: Checked at game end: the Storyteller judges whether the Politician was clearly the single most responsible player; minor contributions do not count.
An evil Politician most responsible for evil losing turns good and wins.
If their team wins, they simply win with it. Alignment detectors see their current (starting) alignment.

test_scenarios.name: Politician causes loss
test_scenarios.actions: Final 3: Alice talks the town out of executing; Bob kills; evil wins.

test_scenarios.name: Not most responsible
test_scenarios.actions: Town executes Dave on its own reasoning.

test_scenarios.name: Poisoned
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Politician, poisoned at game end; she caused the loss.
test_scenarios.expected: Alice does not change alignment and loses.
